network.boundary: All three owned loopback receivers. TLS target counted TCP connections and closed sockets, no TLS handshake assertion. Separate private userData. No external network or credentials. Production UI built from input-r2 source snapshot.

failuresRetained.reason: esbuild inlined native @parcel/watcher package without native asset resolution; externalized to installed package, no source permissiveness change

Product outer-only heartbeat missed infinite opaque child in a different renderer; fixed to framesInSubtree and verified actual termination ~7s. Other failures were fixture syntax, out-of-schema geometry input and optional-error assertion.
Bundler generated a local require shim, so typeof require was not a test of global Node exposure; corrected to globalThis.require. Independent raw browser probe already had undefined require.
P1 cleanup could be overwritten by P2; both chained to previous slot.ready before real controlled-delay regression. This finding was static, not claimed to be a captured failing runtime test.

Main-process IPC bridge exercised through production scoped controller unit and actual native-view IPC; installed full IPC/window UI remains A

Native file chooser interception for opaque OOPIF has only implementation review here; synthetic child guards are additive and do not prove every system chooser route (fresh realms/type mutation). Verify native coverage in isolated A/security acceptance before marking S07 complete.
